methodologyNotes: 12 notable video doorbells selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, covering the spectrum a buyer evaluates: battery vs wired power, cloud-mandatory vs local-storage, subscription-free, HomeKit-native, dual-camera, and premium 4K tiers. Seeds verified and expanded. For each product the manufacturer spec page was attempted first; many manufacturer sites (Ring, Arlo, Eufy, Aqara) blocked WebFetch (403/404/500) or served only page shells. Verified fallbacks used in priority order: (1) manufacturer spec page, (2) Google support spec article (Nest Doorbell), (3) security.org/doorbell-camera/ring/ comparison table (Ring family), (4) wyze.com/products/wyze-video-doorbell-pro/specs (Wyze), (5) macrumors.com/review/aqara-video-doorbell-g4 (Aqara G4), (6) eufy.com/pages/video-doorbell-e340-specification (Eufy E340 resolution/storage), (7) Newegg + Target search listings (prices), (8) digitaltrends.com reviews (Ring Pro 2 FOV/price, Arlo FOV). priceUsd = US MSRP / base-config starting price in USD as of 2026-06-15. Ring Home subscription $4.99/mo (Basic, 1 camera) confirmed on ring.com. Google Home Premium $10/mo confirmed on store.google.com. Arlo Smart subscription $9.99/mo confirmed on arlo.com landing pages. Wyze Cam Plus $1.99-$9.99/mo confirmed on wyze.com. specKeys: resolution (WxH pixels, string), field_of_view_deg (horizontal FOV in degrees, number; null if not verifiable), power (string), local_storage (string or null), cloud_subscription (string describing requirement and base monthly price), night_vision (string), head_to_toe (boolean), release (YYYY or YYYY-MM string or null). accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries. Eufy E340 and S330 FOV not published by eufy.com in any page successfully fetched; left null.

products.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell Plus (2nd Gen)
products.priceNote: MSRP $149.99 confirmed on security.org Ring comparison and Target listing.

specs.cloud_subscription: required; Ring Home Basic from $4.99/mo (1 cam, 180-day history)

products.provenance: security.org Ring comparison table confirms 1536p HD+ resolution, 150° horizontal / 150° vertical FOV, battery power, no local storage, Ring Home subscription required ($4.99-$19.99/mo), color night vision, head-to-toe view, $149.99 MSRP. Ring's own German spec page (ring.com/us/en/products/battery-doorbell-plus fetched as German locale) corroborates 1920×1920 Retinal 2K sensor (Ring markets as 1536p output), 140°H×140°V on their EU page (EU spec slightly differs from US 150°; US 150° used per security.org US-focused table). Color night vision and head-to-toe explicitly confirmed on Ring's page. Release year 2023 per widely reported launch. Quick-release battery pack power source confirmed.

products.name: Google Nest Doorbell (Battery)
products.priceNote: Current retail $129.99 per Target listing. Original MSRP $179.99; Target and Newegg show $129.99-$139.95 as prevailing retail.

specs.cloud_subscription: optional; Google Home Premium $10/mo (includes 60-day event history); free tier limited to 3-hour snapshot history

products.provenance: Google support spec article (support.google.com/googlenest/answer/9259110) confirms: resolution 960×1280 pixels at up to 30 FPS, 145° diagonal wide-angle FOV, built-in rechargeable Li-Ion battery (6 Ah, 3.65V), four 850 nm infrared LEDs for night vision, no local storage. Target search listing confirms battery power, Google Home compatibility, $129.99 retail. Head-to-toe view characteristic of the taller 3:4 portrait aspect ratio (960w×1280h). Release 2021 per widespread August 2021 launch coverage.

Newegg corroborates 1080p FHD, chime included, wireless or wired, $134.97 retail. Aqara's own product page returned 404 throughout session. HomeKit Secure Video integrates with iCloud+ storage tiers ($0.99/mo 50 GB, $2.99/mo 200 GB, $9.99/mo 2 TB per Apple's published pricing). Face recognition and automations via Apple Home. Release year 2022 per product launch and review dates.
